spans.s:
ओल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wet, damp; also ओल्ल.
 m. (-लः) An esculent root,
(Arum campanulatum.)
 E. वल or वल्ल to destroy, (complaints, es-
pecially hœmorrhoids,) अच् affix, व changed to ओ.

ओलड r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) ओलडि (ओलण्डति or ओलण्डयति) To dart or
throw up: some consider the initial vowel to be indicatory, and
make the root लडि q. v.
